items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I can't think of that man's name. He was the conductor of the Los Angeles Philharmonic Orchestra. So I played there with the Junior Philharmonic Orchestra

ctx.x: I studied legitimate music. Just a legitimate background. By the time I got to junior high school, I was the concert master in the band. I was always the concert master in every orchestra that I ever played. I played with the Junior Philharmonic Orchestra here as a child in Los Angeles. I

think the conductor there was Rothstein, Rosenthal, Rothstein or something. I can't think of that man's name. He was the conductor of the Los Angeles Philharmonic Orchestra. So I played there with the Junior Philharmonic Orchestra when I was in junior high school and in high school, legitimate music.
At what age did you take a second instrument?
